title: Taxi drivers have the sheriff attach the instruments
summary: Taxi drivers feared the band would flee on Whyte's bus, so the sheriff took the instruments and the hotel evicted them.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Anyway, all right. He came down there in a big bus and parked it right out in front of that hotel where we were staying. Well, all right. The taxi drivers got scared, thought we were fixing to run off before we made the money to pay them. So they went up to town and got the sheriff, and had the instruments
Buster Smith - 206
attached so we couldn't leave town until we played, made the money and paid them their money so they could go on back home. And they'd seen that big bus, so they thought we were fixing to run off.

All right. The sheriff come down there and takes our horns away from us, let us play with them, and they sit there and watch us, and when we get through playing they come back out there and put them in jail, sat there until we got ready to play the next night.

So now what we gonna do? We said, 'We ain't gonna make enough money here.' Well, all right. Then the man... What throw the fat in the fire, the man in the hotel, he got scared, put us out of the hotel. We didn't have nowhere to stay.
Nowhere to stay.
No money. Nowhere to sleep. Nowhere to sit out on...

Yeah, take anything on the door. See, the boy didn't tell me something. The man's going to pay us, he told us; he's going to pay us some money.
